title: Purani Axamiya Sahityara Saurabha (পুৰণি অসমীয়া সাহিত্যৰ সৌৰভ)
author: Dr. Nabin Chandra Sarma (ড° নবীন চন্দ্ৰ শৰ্মা)
description: A seminal philological and literary exposition on ancient Assamese literature and manuscripts, analyzing manuscript traditions (Sanchi-pat), prose style development under the Ahom royal court, and the symbiotic influence of Tai scribal traditions (Lik) on eastern Indic literary expression.
source: Guwahati: Bani Prakash, Archive ID: in.ernet.dli.2015.452054
